description: Use this when the user asks how their Fantasy Premier League gameweek went: 'how did my team do?', 'review my gameweek', 'was my captain right?', 'did my transfers work?', 'how many points did my bench score?'. Their points vs the average, gameweek and overall rank, captain vs the best captain they had, bench points, auto-subs, and each transfer's points in vs out. Live during a gameweek. Needs the team ID: if the user gives a number with 'my team', that's it; reuse it if they gave it earlier in this conversation.

gameweek.description: Default: the current gameweek (the last one if it hasn't started).

team.description: The user's FPL team ID: the number after /entry/ in the address of their FPL Points page (fantasy.premierleague.com/entry/1234567/event/6). The whole link works too. Once the user has given it, reuse it for every later question in this conversation; don't ask again.
